description: Check an HTTP MCP server's OAuth discovery the way a client that follows the spec walks it, without logging in: the 401 and its WWW-Authenticate, the protected resource metadata, the authorization server's metadata, PKCE and registration. Use it when a server answers 401 or a client cannot sign in. Sends unauthenticated requests to the URL and to the metadata addresses it names; no credentials, no tokens.
name: check_auth
